sources.title: Qwen3.8-27B VRAM Requirements: 13GB to 54GB, Explained
sources.snippet: How much VRAM will Qwen3.8-27B need? Projections say ~17GB at 4-bit. The quant ladder, the context math, and which GPUs actually work.

sources.title: baa-ai/Qwen3.8-27B-RAM-31GB-GGUF · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Mixed-precision, imatrix-calibrated GGUF of Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B, prepared by baa.ai. This is the language model (text) GGUF; for the vision-preserving build use the MLX sibling.

sources.title: Run Qwen 3.8 27B on AMD Ryzen™ AI Max Agentic PCs and Radeon ™ GPUs
sources.snippet: Qwen3.8 27B arrives with Day 0 support on AMD Ryzen™ AI processors and Radeon™ graphics cards. Run the latest Qwen model locally with LM Studio on supported AMD hardware. Build and ship local AI applications with Lemonade and first-class AMD inference support.

sources.title: 27B AI on your Pc? AMD Just made It possible with Qwen3.8 27B
sources.snippet: 27B AI on your Pc? AMD Just made It possible with Qwen3.8 27B AMD has brought Day 0 support for Qwen3.8 27B to compatible Ryzen AI Max+ and Radeon AI PRO R9700 systems, allowing developers to run the 27B model locally with reported speeds of up to 51.8 tokens per second.

sources.title: Qwen3.8-27B GGUF: Which Quant to Download for Your GPU
sources.snippet: Qwen3.8 27B — Ali baba's dense 27-billion-parameter model, Apache 2.0 weights released August 13-14, 2026 — runs unusually cheap locally because its hybrid attention caches only 16 of its 64 layers, so a 4-bit quant on 24GB comfortably carries 32K-64K tokens of context.
